Achievements.Name: Walk the Line
Achievements.Description: Have only aces on all four home stacks at one time in Klondike.

Achievements.Name: Suited Up
Achievements.Description: Build up a full suit, ace to king, on any one home stack in Spider Solitaire.

Achievements.Name: Lucky Devil
Achievements.Description: In Klondike, get an ace on every home stack without ever taking a card from the deck.

Achievements.Name: Flip 'Em and Squish 'Em
Achievements.Description: Flip over 1000 cards in Spider Solitaire.

Achievements.Name: Try Tri
Achievements.Description: In Tri-Peaks, move three cards in a row to the deck from the peak.

Achievements.Name: Peaks and Valleys
Achievements.Description: Move every card, ace through king, from the peak to the deck in Tri-Peaks.

Achievements.Name: Sprint
Achievements.Description: Win a game in less than 3 minutes in Klondike.

Achievements.Name: Eight-Legged Streak
Achievements.Description: Win eight consecutive games in Spider Solitaire.

Achievements.Name: Around the World
Achievements.Description: In Tri-Peaks, get one of each card in a single streak without drawing a new card from the deck.

Achievements.Name: A New Challenger Appears!
Achievements.Description: Win a game in each of the three solitaire games.

Achievements.Name: First One's Free
Achievements.Description: Play one round in any game to completion.

Achievements.Name: Pin Collecting 101
Achievements.Description: Complete any one set of pins.

Achievements.Name: Master Collector
Achievements.Description: Complete all the sets of pins.

Achievements.Name: Look at You!
Achievements.Description: Earn your very first pin.

Achievements.Name: Reach
Achievements.Description: Reach level 1 in all of the Masteries.

Achievements.Name: Harvest
Achievements.Description: Reach level 19 in all of the Masteries.

Achievements.Name: All Natural
Achievements.Description: Go up a level in any Game Mastery without ever taking a spin at the Bonus Wheel.

Achievements.Name: Listen! You Smell Something?
Achievements.Description: Play your first sound.

Achievements.Name: Spin-Spun-Fun
Achievements.Description: Land on the Super Spin at the Bonus Wheel.

Achievements.Name: Spinner
Achievements.Description: Spin the chest shelves and land unaided on the same shelf three times in a row.
